message.content:
A nonstop commercial flight from **Los Angeles International Airport (LAX)** to **Miami International Airport (MIA)** usually takes roughly **5½–6 hours** under normal conditions.  

| Factor | Typical effect |
|--------|----------------|
| Direct flight | ≈ 5 hrs 40 min (average) |
| Wind/air‑traffic delays | ± 10–20 minutes |
| Airline & routing variations | 5 hr 15 min – 6 hr 00 min |

So if you're booking a direct ticket, plan for about **five and a half hours** of flying time. If your itinerary includes stops or connecting legs, add those durations separately.
